name: RxJS User-Friendly Names
description: User-friendly names for technical RxJS operator names, built from a 67-token grammar where every token has one meaning and the name states the policy. Interactive list with search and a grammar token filter.

name: RxJS Operator Finder
description: Find RxJS operators by order, time/value, and intent.

name: RxJS Operators Documentation
description: 265-page comprehensive RxJS operator reference using the Eight-Policy Framework.

name: RxJS Insights
description: 14 thematic analyses of RxJS derived from AI conversations, books, and personal research.

name: RxJS Deep Dive Course
description: 16-module course covering reactive architecture, operator policies, flattening strategies, and state streams. The domain can change — the RxJS machine stays the same.

name: RxJS Operator Semantics
description: Semantic fingerprints for 111 RxJS operators — behavior descriptions generated from a twelve-coordinate semantic model.

name: RxJS Subject Multicast Strategies
description: Every multicasting strategy from RxJS 4 to RxJS 7 — mechanics, runnable samples per strategy, Vitest-pinned reset profiles, the faithful-migration map, and an interactive Reset Flags Playground.

name: RxJS Visualizer
description: Sixty rxjs 7.8.2 marble tests and four pipelines, run through the real TestScheduler and played back one frame per column. Created with the help of Claude Fable 5.1.
